analysis: Post-hoc descriptive scoring of existing AUV concept trace outputs

definitions.requirement_linked_micro_f1: Existing scorer's set F1 over (GID, Concept, Instance, Instance_of), with Concept falling back to Instance_of; scores include type metadata.
definitions.instance_edge_f1: Set F1 over nonblank (GID, Instance) edges; ignores type metadata and concept-only entries.
definitions.summary_mean: Arithmetic mean of per-run metrics, not a pooled F1.

limitations: One AUV requirement set; run counts are not counts of independent engineering systems.
Post-hoc descriptive comparison; no causal superiority, equivalence or significance claim.
June and corrected protocols are reported separately and never pooled.
The June upstream-input isolation defect limits interpretation of its end-to-end comparisons.
Reference normalisations and prompt conventions apply; raw and alias-aware tuple scores are both retained.
No downstream trace comparison is possible where single-generator traces were not requested.
Full-pipeline token ratios do not measure concept-trace-specific cost.
validation: Independent set-intersection precision/recall/F1 agrees with the existing scorer for all 100 outputs.
